Title: View reports card on Home opens the Reports page
Step Action: Open http://localhost:1688/Home.aspx as a signed-in external user.
Step Expected: The home page loads with the h1 VETQAS Proficiency Testing.

Step Action: Look for the View reports card under the Results section.
Step Expected: The View reports card is visible.

Step Action: Click the View reports card.
Step Expected: The browser navigates to the address path /Tabulations.aspx.

Step Action: Read the main heading of the page that opened.
Step Expected: The h1 reads Reports.

Step Action: Read the browser tab title.
Step Expected: The title reads Tabulations - Proficiency Testing and no server error page is shown.

Title: Reports page shows the search form and the empty-state message
Step Action: Open http://localhost:1688/Tabulations.aspx as a signed-in external user.
Step Expected: The page loads with the h1 Reports and no server error page is shown.

Step Action: Read the labels of the search form.
Step Expected: The labels Distribution Reference, Scheme Code and Scheme Name are shown.

Step Action: Look for the search buttons.
Step Expected: The SEARCH button and the SHOW ALL button are visible.

Step Action: Read the message below the search form.
Step Expected: The message reads There are no distributions to display.

Step Action: Check the page for a server error message.
Step Expected: No server error page is shown.

Title: Searching reports with an unknown reference keeps the empty result and SHOW ALL restores the list
Step Action: Open http://localhost:1688/Tabulations.aspx as a signed-in external user.
Step Expected: The page loads with the h1 Reports.

Step Action: Type ZZ-NO-SUCH-REF in the Distribution Reference box.
Step Expected: The box shows ZZ-NO-SUCH-REF.

Step Action: Click the SEARCH button.
Step Expected: The page reloads with the h1 Reports and no server error page is shown.

Step Action: Read the message below the search form.
Step Expected: The message reads There are no distributions to display.

Step Action: Click the SHOW ALL button.
Step Expected: The page reloads with the h1 Reports and the search form is still shown.

Step Action: Read the Distribution Reference box and the message.
Step Expected: The Distribution Reference box is cleared or empty and the message reads There are no distributions to display.

Title: Reports page keeps its heading after a reload and Back returns to Home
Step Action: Open http://localhost:1688/Home.aspx as a signed-in external user.
Step Expected: The home page loads with the h1 VETQAS Proficiency Testing.

Step Action: Click the View reports card.
Step Expected: The h1 reads Reports.

Step Action: Reload the page.
Step Expected: The page reloads and no server error page is shown.

Step Action: Read the main heading of the page.
Step Expected: The h1 is still Reports.

Step Action: Select the browser Back button.
Step Expected: The browser returns to the address path /Home.aspx.

Step Action: Read the main heading of the page.
Step Expected: The h1 reads VETQAS Proficiency Testing and no server error page is shown.
